# Set Sail

> Set Sail is a delightful screen recorder for macOS and Windows, made by Pip Turner. Record your whole screen, a window or a region, with a webcam bubble, microphone and system audio. There's no account, and recordings save straight to a folder on your own computer. It's in free beta.

- Records the whole screen, a single window, or a region you drag out
- Webcam bubble you can move and resize during a recording, with a choice of shape, size, soft edge, shadow and background blur
- Microphone and system audio, each switchable before and during a recording (system audio needs macOS 13 or later on a Mac)
- Pause and resume from a small control strip that never appears in the recording
- Transcripts made on your own computer with Whisper, exportable as text
- Every take levelled to -16 LUFS, -1 dBTP
- Set Sail's own windows stay out of the recording
- Crash reports and usage stats are off unless you turn them on
